_what_this_is: the discover step's proposals (model call); the confirm step looks each up in the registries

proposals.title: Effectiveness of interventions for improving educational outcomes for people with disabilities in low‐ and middle‐income countries: A systematic review
proposals.why: Most recent Campbell systematic review directly answering what works for disability education in LMICs, covering 28 studies.

proposals.title: Implementation of Inclusive Education: A Systematic Review of Studies of Inclusive Education Interventions in Low- and Lower-Middle-Income Countries
proposals.container: International Journal of Disability, Development and Education
proposals.why: First systematic review of inclusive education interventions specifically in low- and lower-middle-income countries; 31 studies across 19 countries.

proposals.title: Teacher professional development for disability inclusion in low‐ and middle‐income Asia‐Pacific countries: An evidence and gap map
proposals.why: Evidence and gap map on teacher training interventions for disability inclusion across LMIC Asia-Pacific; 50 studies identified.

proposals.title: Evidence and gap map of studies assessing the effectiveness of interventions for people with disabilities in low‐and middle‐income countries
proposals.why: Foundational Campbell EGM mapping all disability intervention evidence in LMICs, including 40 education studies; identifies evidence gaps.

proposals.title: Inclusive Education and Children with Disabilities: Quality Education for All in Low and Middle Income Countries
proposals.why: Systematic literature review commissioned by CBM examining education strategies for children with disabilities in LMICs; widely cited baseline.

proposals.title: Inclusive Education and Children with Disabilities: Quality Education for All in Low and Middle Income Countries
proposals.why: Policy brief synthesising 131 peer-reviewed articles on quality education outcomes for children with disabilities in LMICs mainstream and special settings.

proposals.title: Global Education Monitoring Report 2020: Inclusion and education: All means all
proposals.why: UNESCO's flagship global assessment of inclusive education policies and financing across 209 countries, covering disability as a key dimension.

proposals.title: A Guide for ensuring inclusion and equity in education
proposals.why: UNESCO operational guideline for governments on building inclusive education systems, with examples from LMICs including disability-specific approaches.
